settingsBody: Manage the connection, plugins, who can open the vault, and backups.
settingsPluginsDescription: Install catalogs of paints, schemes, and templates from GitHub, or package your own to share.
settingsOwnerSignedIn: Vault owner · signed in on this device
settingsSignInRequiredDescription: Visitors must sign in before they can see or change vault data.
settingsSignInOffDescription: Anyone who can reach this server can open the vault. Use only on a trusted network.
settingsSignInOffWarning: Sign-in is off. Turn it on before exposing this server beyond your home network.
settingsBackupsDescription: A backup is one .zip file with everything in this vault: miniatures and photos, paints, recipes, schemes, templates and installed plugins.
settingsAccountExcluded: Your account and password aren't included.
settingsRestoreDescription: You'll see what the backup contains and choose how to restore it before anything changes.
settingsMergeDescription: Adds what this vault doesn't have yet. Anything already here stays as it is.
settingsReplaceDescription: Removes everything in this vault and restores the backup exactly. Your account is kept.
settingsLegacyBackup: This backup is from an earlier version of Paintwarden. It doesn't include plugins or photos, so it can only be merged. Install the plugins it uses first.
settingsReplacingWarning: Replacing can't be undone. Export a backup of this vault first if you might want its current contents.
settingsTurnOffSignInDescription: Anyone who can reach this server will be able to open and change the vault.
settingsRequireSignInDescription: Visitors will need your username and password to open the vault.
settingsChangePasswordDescription: Enter your current password to set a new one.
settingsChangeUsernameDescription: Enter your current password to choose a new username. You stay signed in on this device.
